description: Software Factory enforcement for the GitHub Copilot CLI: agents propose, the CLI and these hooks decide. Native Copilot format (camelCase events, flat outputs); no matchers — each script filters by the normalised tool name.

sessionStart.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE

userPromptSubmitted.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/prompt.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/prompt.js" userPromptSubmitted; exit $LASTEXITCODE

preToolUse.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/guard.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/guard.js" preToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE

postToolUse.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/activity.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/activity.js" postToolUse; exit $LASTEXITCODE

subagentStart.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/activity.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/activity.js" subagentStart; exit $LASTEXITCODE

subagentStop.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/subagent-stop.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/subagent-stop.js" subagentStop; exit $LASTEXITCODE

agentStop.powershell: $r = if ($env:PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:PLUGIN_ROOT } elseif ($env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT) { $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT } else { $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/stop.js")) { exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/stop.js" agentStop; exit $LASTEXITCODE
